title: German Shepherd Dog Mug | Yellow Gradient Silhouette
description:
This 11oz white ceramic mug brings warmth to quiet mornings and busy workdays. A graceful silhouette of a German Shepherd stands against a sunrise gradient — amber and gold streaming into soft orange — capturing that loyal, watchful spirit in every sip. It feels like a companion on early walks, a steady presence during late-night study sessions, and a cheerful start to slow weekend routines. The comfortable C-handle sits naturally in your hand while the vibrant ORCA-coated print resists fading, leaving the design bright through many washes and reheats. For anyone who loves the calm confidence of a shepherd at their side, this mug slips seamlessly into everyday life and small rituals.

Product features
- 11 oz white ceramic mug with C-handle
- Dishwasher-safe for easy cleaning
- Microwave-safe for reheating drinks
- Vibrant, long-lasting colors with AAA+ ORCA coating
- Durable ORCA coating that preserves print luster

Care instructions
- Clean in dishwasher or wash by hand with warm water and dish soap
